criterion: No held-out AE4-null secretion value or qualitative timing enters any objective; bound; prior; branch/root choice; input waveform; stopping rule; model-generation choice; or code constant before freeze.
evidence_required: Static scan; objective and configuration audit; provenance log; optimizer history.
failure_condition: Any direct or indirect target-derived dependency is found.

criterion: cAMP/PKA/AE4 regulatory gains; delays; and time constants are fixed from WT/regulatory evidence independently of knockout secretion.
evidence_required: Regulatory fit inputs; frozen parameter manifest; reveal log.
failure_condition: A regulatory parameter or family is selected using knockout secretion behavior.

criterion: S173A is represented only as dependence of the PKA-mediated effect unless direct phosphorylation is independently demonstrated.
evidence_required: Primary-source ledger; code comments; final claims.
failure_condition: S173 is treated as directly phosphorylated fact without direct evidence.

criterion: Static/dynamic families and common-capacity/state-specific modulation are compared as nested alternatives; extra states/rates require discriminating WT evidence.
evidence_required: Nested fits; residuals; complexity decision log.
failure_condition: A flexible family is retained using knockout behavior or without WT discrimination.

criterion: All states; parameters; rates; currents; molar fluxes; areas; volumes; and time conversions have compatible units; current-to-moles uses charge and Faraday exactly once.
evidence_required: Dimensional ledger; executable unit tests; conversion derivations.
failure_condition: Mismatch; missing/double Faraday factor; or uncertified physical time remains.

criterion: Source directions and membrane signs follow a declared convention and pass independent reversal/equilibrium checks.
evidence_required: Source matrix; sign table; reversal tests.
failure_condition: A sign is arbitrary or produces wrong reversal.

criterion: Acid-base dynamics account for intracellular/luminal inorganic carbon; buffer binding; bath exchange; and advection without internal carbon creation.
evidence_required: Analytical carbon identity; closed/open-system numerical residuals.
failure_condition: Carbon residual exceeds declared tolerance after boundary fluxes.

criterion: Species stoichiometry and current accounting conserve charge; electroneutral cycles have zero net transported charge.
evidence_required: Charge vector times source matrix; current residual tests.
failure_condition: Cycle charge or current residual exceeds tolerance.

criterion: Water law has compatible units; positive volumes; and closed compartment balance including outflow.
evidence_required: Water-balance derivation; positivity and scaling tests.
failure_condition: Internal water creation/loss; nonpositive volume; or unit inconsistency.

criterion: Apical and basolateral current closure are each demonstrated.
evidence_required: Per-membrane current residuals at roots and trajectories.
failure_condition: Either membrane remains unbalanced in a state claimed closed.

criterion: Apical pump/K fractions are labelled unmeasured unless quantified; conserve total capacity; and have exact baseline nesting limits.
evidence_required: Primary-source ledger; parameter registry; nesting tests.
failure_condition: Fraction is mislabeled measured; capacity changes silently; or nesting fails.

criterion: WT roots use deterministic multistart across the declared physiological domain; all admissible/remote branches are reported; selection rule is predeclared.
evidence_required: Root table; starts; bounds; clustering; branch rule.
failure_condition: Convenient local root only; ignored remote root; or post-reveal branch change.

criterion: Decisive trajectories reproduce with two independent stiff solvers; tolerance sweeps; and nearby initial states.
evidence_required: Solver crosscheck table and trajectory differences.
failure_condition: Result depends materially on solver; tolerances; or initial condition.

criterion: Accepted mechanisms do not depend on arbitrary fitted bounds; profiles distinguish supported constraints from compensation.
evidence_required: Parameter-bound distances; profiles; covariance/perturbation tests.
failure_condition: Gate passes only at an arbitrary bound or via undisclosed correlation.

criterion: Added modules have source directions capable of correcting the documented residual; fitting does not hide wrong/rank-deficient topology.
evidence_required: Source-matrix rank; residual-direction projection; nested topology tests.
failure_condition: Correction is solely compensatory in an incapable or rank-deficient direction.

criterion: AE4 deletion removes every AE4 transport/regulatory contribution and leaves unrelated parameters/inputs unchanged.
evidence_required: Symbolic dependency scan; zero-activity equivalence test; manifest diff.
failure_condition: AE4 term remains or another pathway is genotype-retuned.

criterion: AE2 deletion remains independent validation and does not acquire an unsupported large secretion role.
evidence_required: AE2 genotype simulation; evidence comparison; calibration dependency scan.
failure_condition: AE2 is compensatory fit freedom or predicts unsupported large output effect.

criterion: Every retained complexity increment differs falsifiably from its simpler exact nested model on allowed WT/transporter evidence.
evidence_required: Exact nesting tests; WT model comparison; decision log.
failure_condition: Simpler model passes equally and complex mechanism is called required/identified.

criterion: Qualitative conclusions persist over source-supported uncertainty including apical fractions; weak kinetics; and initial luminal states.
evidence_required: Uncertainty ensemble/profile and classification stability.
failure_condition: Conclusion reverses within allowed uncertainty without disclosure.

criterion: Claims about 2018 remain scoped to the inherited historical-lineage implementation/tested domain; chassis failure is not used to judge AE4 biology.
evidence_required: Report-wide language scan and source ledger.
failure_condition: Claims say/imply paper wrong; globally invalid; or AE4 insufficient.

criterion: Physical time map; calcium/beta inputs; and horizon are fixed from WT/independent evidence before knockout reveal.
evidence_required: Dynamic calibration inputs; frozen manifest; reveal log.
failure_condition: Timing or stimulus feature is inferred from held-out knockout curve.

criterion: Valid WT resting and physically timed stimulated trajectories exist before normalized KO/WT secretion is interpreted.
evidence_required: WT gate report; root table; time ledger; execution chronology.
failure_condition: Normalized ratio masks invalid WT; failed gate; or uncertified time axis.

criterion: Unmeasured luminal states; lumen volume/outflow; and apical fractions are profiled rather than silently fixed for genotype behavior.
evidence_required: Parameter provenance; sensitivity/profile runs.
failure_condition: An unmeasured coordinate controls result but is fixed without provenance/sensitivity.

criterion: Every equation/final mechanistic claim distinguishes measurement; derived constraint; numerical result; historical record; and new assumption.
evidence_required: Equation registry; provenance docs; claim audit.
failure_condition: Model decision is presented as measured or numerical fit as mechanism identification.
